assistworld-assist-world:lever:5ffd7f03-.title: Sales Development Representative (Virtual Assistant)
assistworld-assist-world:lever:5ffd7f03-.description: About the Company Creating Logistics Services is a full-service trucking company based in Houston, Texas, specialising in flatbed freight. We haul steel, machinery, construction materials, lumber, and anything that goes on a trailer. As we scale our operations, we're building out a dedicated sales team to drive new business and expand our client base. Role Overview We're looking for a driven and articulate Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join our growing virtual team. In this role, you'll be the first point of contact with prospective clients — identifying leads, making outbound calls, and booking qualified appointments for our senior sales closers. This is a high-impact role for someone who is hungry, organised, and confident on the phone. Key Responsibilities • Generate and build targeted lead lists using Apollo and other lead generation tools • Research and identify key decision-makers at potential shipping companies across industries such as steel, construction, manufacturing, and heavy equipment • Conduct outbound cold calls to prospective shipping clients • Follow up with freight leads to maintain pipeline activity • Qualify leads and set up appointments with the senior sales team to close deals • Accurately update and maintain CRM systems with customer information, call notes, and follow-up tasks • Meet daily and weekly outreach targets • Collaborate with the team to refine scripts, messaging, and targeting strategies Requirements • Fluent, professional English — both written and spoken (non-negotiable) • Strong communication skills and confidence making outbound sales calls • Experience in logistics, trucking, freight brokerage, or transportation is highly preferred • Familiarity with CRM systems (Close CRM, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or similar) • Comfortable using lead generation tools such as Apollo • Organised, motivated, and dependable — able to work independently in a remote environment • Reliable internet connection and a professional home office setup • Ability to work Monday to Friday, Central Standard Time (CST), 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Nice to Have (Bonus Points) • Prior experience in freight, logistics, or transportation — knowing the language (rate per mile, flatbed, hotshot, etc.) is a BIG plus • Experience using Close CRM or a sales-specific dialer • Background in B2B sales targeting commercial or industrial companies

blackboxstrategies-blackbox-strategies:a.title: Outbound & Lifecycle Marketing Specialist
blackboxstrategies-blackbox-strategies:a.description: OUTBOUND & LIFECYCLE MARKETING SPECIALIST ROLE OVERVIEW BlackBox Strategies is seeking a senior, execution-first operator to own outbound and lifecycle messaging across both B2B and B2C audiences. This role is ideal for someone who: - Is an expert at hands-on execution - Can collaborate on strategy, then independently ship - Understands how B2B and B2C motions differ across email, CRM, and SMS - Works closely with a Social Media Manager to align messaging and timing You will partner with leadership on direction and priorities, then own execution end-to-end. ABOUT BLACKBOX STRATEGIES BlackBox Strategies is a revenue execution agency that helps businesses grow through disciplined GTM strategy, outbound execution, and lifecycle optimization. We design and operate revenue systems across email, CRM, and digital channels—bridging strategy and hands-on execution to drive measurable results for both B2B and B2C clients. LOCATION Remote | Open to global candidates (U.S. business hours required) KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Cold Email & Outbound Execution - Build and maintain outbound lists and enrichment workflows using Clay - Launch, manage, and optimize cold email campaigns in Instantly - Own inbox health, deliverability, warm-up, and reply categorization - Sync replies, outcomes, and lifecycle stages into HubSpot - Continuously test messaging by segment, persona, and intent Lifecycle & Marketing Email (B2B + B2C) - Build segmented audiences across lead, prospect, and customer stages - Execute nurture, re-engagement, abandoned inquiry, and expansion campaigns - Manage compliance, suppression logic, and list hygiene - Use HubSpot Marketing Hub and/or Mailchimp SMS Marketing (Nice to Have) - Support compliant, high-intent SMS use cases (follow-ups, reminders, re-engagement) - Experience with platforms such as Twilio or similar is a strong plus - Coordinate SMS timing with email and social campaigns Cross-Functional Collaboration - Collaborate closely with the Social Media Manager to align themes, CTAs, and timing - Share outbound insights to inform social and content strategy - Partner with leadership on ICPs, testing priorities, and iteration REQUIREMENTS - Minimum of 4 years of hands-on experience in outbound, lifecycle marketing, or RevOps-adjacent roles - Direct experience executing (not just overseeing) email and CRM campaigns - Experience supporting both B2B and B2C audiences - Strong understanding of deliverability, segmentation, and channel tradeoffs - Clear written communicator with a bias toward execution - Comfortable operating with high-level direction in a fast-moving environment BENEFITS - Competitive compensation - Flexible, fully remote work environment - Opportunity to directly influence pipeline and revenue - Close collaboration with strategy, social, and GTM leadership - Exposure to modern outbound, CRM, and AI-enabled workflows

DIS-TRAN Steel’s leadership team lives by our company values, modeling our culture of respect and integrity each day. We're a team that likes to have fun, but we also know how to get stuff done. DIS-TRAN Steel, located in Chicago Heights, IL, is looking for Machine Operators to join our team. Machine Operators must be capable of operating machines in a steel plant. Individuals must possess the ability to read a tape measure and must possess basic math aptitude. Machine Operators will safely operate CNC machinery (drill, saw, etc.). Individuals will perform daily preventative maintenance on machines.

flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.title: Director, Antibody Discovery
flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: Position Summary: Quotient is seeking a Director or Senior Director of Antibody Discovery. This role will define and lead Quotient’s antibody discovery strategy; leading the delivery of therapeutic antibody projects in addition to Quotient’s antibody drug discovery platform build through the deployment of cutting-edge technologies. This role will require close involvement in the end-to-end process of translating Somatic Genomics screening outputs (i.e. candidate genes and potential drug targets) into initiation of drug discovery programs. This role will also involve senior project leadership, steering drug discovery matrix teams from early conception through to key inflection points such as development candidate nomination and IND submission. Responsibilities: Provide balanced expert advice on the feasibility of antibody tractable targets and the conception of high-value drug molecules Present antibody discovery strategies to internal R&D committees to justify capital commitment in new programs Drive decision making on construct design, format and developability for new antibody programs according to Target Product Profile specifications Independently carry out lead sequence and format optimizations utilizing rational, structure-based and in silico/AI/ML design approaches Drive rapid optimization of novel antibody and protein therapeutics through iterative design, build, test, and learn cycles As a drug discovery project leader, develop efficient and balanced project plans for one or more biologic drug discovery programs and lead a cross-functional team to execute through lead generation, development candidate nomination and IND submission Model best matrix leadership behaviours and support an emphasis on enterprise leadership across the company Identify, select, and manage external CROs/vendors, consultants, and academic collaborators to deliver a virtual/outsourced state-of-the-art drug antibody discovery platform for the identification of high-quality mAb molecules at pace Build and maintain networks of external experts to pressure-test hypotheses and refine strategies Serve as a specialist antibody discovery expert within Quotient’s drug discovery team and across the company. Contribute to broader corporate strategy, BD evaluations, and exploratory platform initiatives Qualifications: Essential Proven experience advancing protein therapeutics through drug discovery phases to development. Expertise in structure-based protein engineering and design of antibodies including (multispecifics, Fc engineering, fusion proteins etc) Skilled in antibody engineering, including use of in silico, structure-based, and AI/ML approaches to sequence/CDR design, use of display technologies, humanization techniques, sequence liability remediation, analytics, and developability (biophysical) assessment and improvement Project leadership experience in pharmaceutical industry R&D environment across multiple therapeutic areas, with a deep understanding of lead identification and optimization through preclinical development of antibody therapeutics Track record of advocating for acquisition or creation of new technologies for accelerated antibody design, expression, and characterization Desirable Experience in early-stage or start-up biotech environments Experience working with genetic and genomics platform-driven drug target discovery Broader understanding of protein sciences (expression, developability, and analytical purification and analysis) Experience managing the design and validation of cellular assays for the functional characterization of engineered biologics Values and Behaviors: Encourage respectful disagreement and cultivate open-minded, ego-free interactions to continuously push each other towards excellence Seek out diverse perspectives; practice active listening and genuine curiosity to ensure all contributions are valued, regardless of source Recognize the impact of your behavior, language and attitudes, and strive for balanced, m

jobgether-jobgether:lever:0553859c-a51d-.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:0553859c-a51d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI/ML Engineer based in United Kingdom. This is an opportunity to develop AI and machine learning solutions that support the personalization of digital therapies and improve patient outcomes. You’ll work with longitudinal real-world health data to build models that can predict risks and enable more adaptive approaches to care. The role spans the full ML lifecycle, from data pipelines and model development through validation, deployment, and production integration. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering and multidisciplinary teams to translate advanced models into reliable digital health products. A strong focus on explainability, reproducibility, privacy, and regulatory requirements makes this a technically rigorous environment. You’ll also have the opportunity to explore generative AI applications for patient education and digital coaching. This is a high-impact role for an experienced ML professional who wants to apply AI to meaningful healthcare challenges. Design, develop, train, and evaluate supervised and unsupervised machine learning models using longitudinal and real-world health data. Build scalable and reliable data pipelines supporting model training, testing, validation, and deployment. Develop machine learning solutions capable of identifying health risks, supporting personalized interventions, and enabling adaptive care pathways. Work closely with software and engineering teams to integrate ML models into production Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) and digital therapeutic solutions. Establish robust processes for model reproducibility, monitoring, evaluation, and performance optimization. Ensure models and ML workflows meet relevant requirements around explainability, reliability, privacy, and regulatory compliance. Apply appropriate techniques for real-world signal processing, data preparation, feature engineering, and model validation. Contribute to the evaluation and responsible adoption of generative AI technologies for healthcare education, coaching, and related applications. Collaborate with cross-functional experts to translate clinical and behavioral health challenges into effective technical solutions. Contribute to the continuous improvement of machine learning infrastructure, development practices, and MLOps processes. Requirements: 4+ years of professional experience in AI/ML engineering, machine learning, data science, or a closely related field, ideally involving digital health or healthcare datasets. Strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience with data wrangling, machine learning development, and real-world signal processing. Practical experience with leading ML frameworks and libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and scikit-learn. Experience designing and implementing MLOps pipelines for reliable model development, testing, deployment, and maintenance. Understanding of machine learning applied to longitudinal, real-world, or time-series health data. Familiarity with clinical validation, model evaluation, bias mitigation, and privacy-preserving machine learning practices. Understanding of the challenges associated with deploying AI/ML solutions in regulated healthcare or Software as a Medical Device environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a rigorous and evidence-driven approach to technical decisions. Ability to work collaboratively with engineering, data science, healthcare, and other multidisciplinary stakeholders. Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Interest in generative AI and its responsible application to healthcare education, coaching, and patient support is a plus. Experience working effectively in a remote or distributed environment is preferred. Benefits: Fully remote working environment, with Europe-based candida

jobgether-jobgether:lever:45bbfc36-65b6-.title: Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter)
jobgether-jobgether:lever:45bbfc36-65b6-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter) based in South Africa. This is an opportunity to join an established digital product and contribute to a mobile experience used by a global community. You’ll work on core product journeys including registration, discovery, profiles, messaging, engagement, and monetization. The role combines hands-on Flutter development with a strong focus on analytics, performance, and measurable product outcomes. You’ll help evolve a production mobile application across both iOS and Android while supporting multiple brands and configurations. The environment is remote-first and internationally distributed, with experienced professionals collaborating across cultures and time zones. You’ll work with modern Flutter architecture and tooling while contributing to a product where mobile quality and user engagement directly matter. This role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys ownership, technical depth, and building scalable mobile experiences. Develop and maintain core mobile product experiences across authentication and registration, search and discovery, profiles, photos, messaging, matching, and user engagement. Analyze and improve key product funnels, including registration, upgrades, monetization, messaging engagement, and match or interest conversion. Own and contribute to analytics for core mobile journeys, helping teams understand user behavior and identify opportunities for product improvement. Monitor and improve platform-specific capabilities such as push notifications, deep links, and real-time features. Analyze mobile advertising and in-app purchase revenue metrics and support initiatives designed to improve monetization performance. Support compliance-related analytics and functionality, including consent management, age verification, and user verification. Build and evolve production Flutter applications for both iOS and Android using maintainable, scalable architecture. Contribute to multi-flavor and white-label application delivery, including brand-specific configurations, assets, store identifiers, and Firebase environments. Develop automated tests across unit and widget levels and help maintain high standards of reliability and code quality. Collaborate with product, engineering, analytics, and other cross-functional stakeholders in a fully remote international environment. Requirements Strong professional experience with Flutter and Dart 3.x , including experience delivering and maintaining production applications for both iOS and Android. Solid understanding of layered mobile architecture, including separation between UI, domain/use cases and repositories, and framework layers. Hands-on experience with BLoC and Provider , as well as GetIt for dependency injection and GoRouter for navigation. Experience working with Dio for networking and immutable data models using code generation tools such as built_value or similar technologies. Experience building and shipping multi-flavor or white-label mobile applications, including per-brand configurations, assets, store IDs, and Firebase setups. Practical experience writing automated tests, particularly unit and widget tests; familiarity with bloc_test or BDD-style testing is an advantage. Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, performance, maintainability, and production development practices. Analytical mindset with an interest in using product data and user behavior to improve mobile experiences and business outcomes. Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical responsibilities, and collaborate effectively within a distributed team. Fluent Russian and B2-level English communication skills. Benefits Fully remote, full-time working opportunity. jobgether-jobgether:lever:7c58a73a-2fd4-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Regional Market Executive based in the United States. This role is responsible for building and expanding a high-impact commercial presence within an assigned geographic market. You will act as a market-facing leader, developing strong relationships with employers, brokers, consultants, and strategic referral partners. The position combines market strategy, consultative selling, pipeline development, and new business generation. You will identify emerging opportunities, monitor competitive trends, and translate market insights into measurable growth plans. Success requires close collaboration with sales, product, implementation, client success, and operations teams. You will also represent the organization at industry events and strengthen its reputation within the regional healthcare and benefits community. This is an opportunity for an experienced healthcare sales professional to shape a market while driving sustainable and profitable revenue growth. Serve as the commercial leader and primary market ambassador for the assigned geography, developing and executing a comprehensive market growth strategy aligned with business objectives. Build market awareness and establish a strong presence within the regional healthcare, employee benefits, and consulting communities. Develop annual market business plans with clear, measurable growth objectives and actionable strategies. Monitor market trends, competitive activity, industry developments, and emerging opportunities to identify areas for expansion. Generate consistent net-new revenue through strategic engagement with employers, brokers, consultants, and other referral partners. Develop and maintain trusted-advisor relationships with regional consulting firms and brokerage organizations that influence employer purchasing decisions. Create strategic account plans for priority consulting firms and position the organization as a preferred third-party administrator (TPA) partner. Represent the organization at industry conferences, networking events, and regional leadership forums to strengthen market influence and relationships. Maintain strong sales execution and operational discipline through accurate pipeline management, forecasting, executive opportunity reviews, and CRM practices. Coordinate closely with Implementation, Client Success, Product, Operations, National Account Executives, Strategic Sales Associates, and Channel Sales teams to support successful opportunities and long-term growth. Requirements: 10+ years of successful sales experience within healthcare, employee benefits, third-party administration, or closely related industries. Demonstrated success selling complex, self-funded healthcare solutions in consultative sales environments. Proven track record of consistently achieving or exceeding sales objectives and generating profitable new business. Strong understanding of the healthcare benefits landscape, employer purchasing processes, and consultant- and broker-influenced sales cycles. Ability to develop and execute market strategies, business plans, account plans, and sustainable pipeline-generation initiatives. Strong relationship-building and networking capabilities, particularly with employers, consultants, brokerage firms, and other industry stakeholders. Excellent commercial judgment with the ability to identify market opportunities, understand competitive dynamics, and translate insights into action. Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and serve as a trusted advisor. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with demonstrated discipline around CRM management, forecasting, opportunity reviews, and sales processes. southparkcommons-comun:ashbyhq:d8c79b12-.title: Strategic Finance Lead
southparkcommons-comun:ashbyhq:d8c79b12-.description: About Común Comun’s mission is to help Hispanic immigrants turn their hard work into upward mobility — starting with financial services that support their transition from a cash-based system to the digital economy. We offer checking accounts that can be opened using 100+ types of Latin American IDs, access to over 90K locations nationwide to deposit cash, international transfers to 17 countries at market-leading rates, and 24/7 bilingual customer support with <5 min SLA across email, chat, and phone. We currently process over $1.5B in annual transaction volume and surpassed $100M in annualized international transfers just six months after launch. Comun has raised +$50M from top investors including Redpoint, Costanoa Ventures, and South Park Commons. Our team brings experience from leading fintech companies like Brex, Nubank, and Mercury. We believe immigrants are the ultimate entrepreneurs — driven by relentless ambition and a vision for a better future for their families. Comun exists to serve them throughout their journey. Learn more at comun.app/nosotros http://comun.app/nosotros Article here https://techcrunch.com/2024/08/28/fast-growing-neobank-comun-raised-21-5m-just-months-after-its-last-raise/ ABOUT THE ROLE We're hiring a Strategic Finance Lead to own financial planning, treasury, and the commercial side of our vendor and banking relationships, reporting directly to the founders. This is a high-autonomy role for someone who wants to operate as the finance brain of the company, not manage a large team or run accounting operations. You'll work alongside our controller (who owns accounting and close), product, and growth to drive the company to a 1x burn multiple and durable profitability. We run finance as an AI-first function — agents and automations are the default answer before headcount — and you should want to work that way too. WHAT YOU'LL OWN - Financial planning and analysis: The operating model, 18-month budget, monthly forecasting, and reporting to founders and the board. - Treasury and cash management: Cash positioning across multiple bank accounts, credit facility management and covenant compliance, and liquidity planning, including a 13-week rolling cash flow forecast. - Vendor and partner negotiations: Lead commercial negotiations for key vendor contracts and banking/processing partnerships, from cost modeling through executed terms. - Pricing strategy: Product-level unit economics, interchange dynamics, and margin management across our card and payments products. WHERE THIS ROLE CAN GROW Over time, this role can extend into fundraising support (materials, data room, investor analysis) and broader strategic projects with the founders. WHAT YOU'LL BRING - 5–8 years in finance, ideally starting in investment banking, private equity, or management consulting, followed by strategic finance or FP&A at a startup. - Strong financial modeling skills — you build clean, driver-based models and can defend every number in them. - Commercial instincts: experience negotiating (or supporting negotiation of) vendor, partner, or banking agreements is a strong plus. - Comfort with ambiguity and ownership — you'd rather run a workstream end to end than execute someone else's plan. - AI-fluent: you already use tools like Claude every day and have a point of view on which finance workflows should be automated next. - Fintech experience, particularly with card programs, sponsor banks, or payments economics, is a plus but not required. - Spanish is a plus. - An interest in serving an underserved community :) WHAT'S NOT IN SCOPE Accounting, close, and controllership are owned by our controller. This role has no direct reports today. Team We are a team of 40 based out of New York, coming from industry-leading companies like Brex, Nubank, Cruise, and Verkada. Over half of us are immigrants, and have experienced the problems we’re solving first hand. We value customer focus, high ambition, principled decision-making, and deep trust.
